name: Michael Gahler - § 30 - Am 33
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: 30. Strongly urges all Member States, and in particular the new Hungarian Government, to stop vetoing the opening of negotiating clusters and to cease using Ukraine’s EU membership prospect in domestic politics and political campaigning; welcomes the opening of the first fundamental cluster of accession negotiations and expects that subsequent clusters will follow suit:
